West Bengal enacts new preventive detention law

West Bengal has enacted a new law concerning preventive detention and damage to public property. The law follows a template seen in statutes enacted by other states, including those ruled by the BJP. This move allows for detention to prevent offenses, with similar laws already in place across several Indian states.
